subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should this feature preserve and redirect released `?session=` deep links, or is breaking existing bookmarks and ClickClack discussion links an explicitly approved upgrade policy?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes an already released user-facing URL contract, and repository policy treats compatibility removal and new operator-visible behavior as decisions requiring explicit maintainer intent rather than an implementation-only judgment.

options.title: Preserve released links
options.body: Keep parsing the released query form and replace it with the canonical path so bookmarks and existing ClickClack links survive upgrade.

options.title: Approve a breaking migration
options.body: Accept the removed reader only with explicit release and user-migration communication for existing shared links.

recommendation.title: Preserve released links
recommendation.body: Keep parsing the released query form and replace it with the canonical path so bookmarks and existing ClickClack links survive upgrade.
